senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of לְבֵנָה)to make or pile bricks.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 10:5">B. Mets. X, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 118b:2">118ᵇ</cite>) <he>ואין לוֹבְנִין לבנים</he> but you are not permitted to pile up bricks (on the public road).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 118b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>גובלין טיט … אבל לא לובנין</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. <he>לבנים</he>; Y. ed. <he>ללבינים</he>) you may knead clay on the public road (for immediate use), but you are not permitted to form bricks; (Y. ed.: but not for making bricks).
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:7">ib.</cite> Ohol. XVII, 7.
